name: Atomus
description: DTCG 2025.10 resolver for the Atomus design tokens. Pick one context per modifier (e.g. { "theme": "dark", "brand": "violet", "radius": "round", "breakpoint": "mobile" }); defaults reproduce css/atomus.css :root. Later entries in resolutionOrder win.

primitives.description: Raw colour ramps, alpha steps and the size scale. Alias these from semantic tokens; never use them directly in components.

text-styles.description: Composite typography tokens (Figma text styles). They alias the Typography family tokens, so they resolve after the breakpoint modifier.

brand.description: Brand ramp (brand-25 … brand-950). Every brand-coloured semantic token follows it. Mirrors the Figma Brand collection and [data-brand] in CSS.

theme.description: Light or dark semantic colours and elevation shadows. Mirrors the Figma Color + Effects collections and [data-theme] / .dark in CSS.

radius.description: Corner-radius personality. Mirrors the Figma Radius collection and [data-radius] in CSS.

breakpoint.description: Responsive spacing, layout and typography values. Mirrors the Figma Spacing & Layout + Typography collections (Desktop / Tablet / Mobile modes) and the media queries in css/atomus.css.
